raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart showing the distribution of two related categorical variables, with the outer ring representing “Ambiguity Std” and the inner ring representing “Max Ambiguity.” The outer ring contains four slices in progressively lighter blue shades, labeled in-place with percentages: “Std: 0.0” (dark teal-blue) at about 49.0%, “Std: 0.47” (medium blue) at about 39.0%, “Std: 0.82” (brighter blue) at about 5.0%, and “Std: 0.94” (light cyan-blue) at about 7.0%. The inner ring contains three slices in light blue tones, also labeled with percentages: “Max: 1” (medium-light blue) at about 47.7%, “Max: 2” (light blue) at about 38.0%, and “Max: 3” (very pale blue) at about 14.2%. Two separate legends appear on the right, titled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner),” mapping colors to category labels; no slices are exploded or offset, and the largest segments visually occupy roughly half of their respective rings.
